afterglow_max_h.description: Afterglow doubles after every fruitless snatch of the same item, up to this many hours.

cycle_interval_s.description: Refractory period: seconds between two snatches of the same kind.

dry_run.description: When true, planner creates preview / dry-run runs that do not dispatch searches.

exclude_quality_profiles.description: *arr quality profile ids: items using any of these profiles are never searched. An id may not be in both profile lists. Absent = empty.

exclude_tags.description: *arr tag ids: items carrying any of these tags are never searched. An id may not be in both tag lists. Absent = empty.

hourly_cap.description: Stamina: searches an instance may send to its indexers per hour before it needs a rest (1-500). One per episode, season, movie, album or book; one for a whole artist or author search.

include_quality_profiles.description: *arr quality profile ids: when not empty, only items using one of these profiles are searched. An episode, album or book uses the profile of its series, artist or author; a Chaptarr author counts its audiobook and ebook profiles too. Absent = empty.

include_tags.description: *arr tag ids: when not empty, only items carrying one of these tags are searched. An episode, album or book has the tags of its series, artist or author. Absent = empty.

lidarr_missing_mode.description: Search grouping for Lidarr missing runs; upgrade runs always search per album.

missing_per_cycle.description: How many missing items one snatch goes after (0 disables missing snatches).

processed_ttl_h.description: Afterglow: hours an item rests after a snatch before it may be touched again.

recent_grab_window_h.description: Skip items the *arr grabbed within this many hours (its history) and items already in its download queue; 0 keeps only the queue check.

release_delay_h.description: Skip items released less than this many hours ago; 0 (or absent) turns the delay off. The release date is the one of the app kind: air date (Sonarr, Whisparr v2), the date of radarr_release_type (Radarr, Whisparr v3), the album or book release date. Items without a date are kept.

selection.description: random spreads searches over the library, sequential walks it with a cursor, recent prefers the newest releases with a slice reserved for the backlog

skip_unavailable_movies.description: Radarr only: skip movies Radarr reports as not yet available (isAvailable false, the movie's minimum availability is not reached). They are not searched and cost no stamina. Movies without the flag are searched. Absent = true.

upgrade_per_cycle.description: How many cutoff-unmet items one snatch goes after (0 disables upgrade snatches).

api_key.description: Required on create; omit on update to keep the stored key

match_broken_below_percent.description: Album or book match percentage below which a release is considered broken (default 40; used by rematch fallback).

match_fixable_min_percent.description: Minimum album or book match percentage for fixable manual import (default 75).

max_imports_per_sweep.description: Most id_matched imports one sweep sends per instance. Optional on write so older clients keep working; left out, it takes the default of 25. Reads always return it.

min_custom_format_score.description: Lowest custom format score an item may have; left out, the unwanted_score rule is off.

track_broken_below_percent.description: Track match percentage below which a release is considered broken (default 40; used by rematch fallback).

track_fixable_min_percent.description: Minimum track match percentage for fixable manual import (default 50).

blocklist.description: Blocklist the release when the rule removes the item. Left out on write, the rule keeps its default (every rule except not_an_upgrade, duplicate and unwanted_unmonitored blocklists); reads always return the effective value.

duplicate.description: Strikes every download for an episode, movie, album or book except the one with the highest custom-format score; a tie keeps the lowest queue id. Optional on write so older clients keep working; left out, the rule takes its default settings. Reads always return it.

id_matched.description: Force-imports a Sonarr or Radarr download the *arr matched to its series or movie by ID only, through a ManualImport of its clean, mapped candidates; it never removes or blocklists (ADR-0013). Optional on write so older clients keep working; left out, the rule takes its default settings. Reads always return it.

import_broken.description: Strikes and removes a download whose release is broken (e.g. no tracks matched, corrupt container, parser error) with blocklist and re-search. Optional on write; left out, the rule takes its default settings. Reads always return it.

import_fixable.description: Force-imports a download whose import rejections are fixable (e.g. Lidarr/Readarr track/album match above floor, scene numbering mismatch); never removes or blocklists. Optional on write; left out, the rule takes its default settings. Reads always return it.

import_not_wanted.description: Strikes and removes a download that is not wanted (e.g. release not requested, fewer tracks than existing release) with blocklist, without re-search. Optional on write; left out, the rule takes its default settings. Reads always return it.

metadata_stuck.description: Strikes and removes a torrent download stuck fetching metadata. Optional on write so older clients keep working; left out, the rule takes its default settings. Reads always return it.

not_an_upgrade.description: Strikes a download whose custom-format score does not beat the file already on disk (Sonarr and Radarr). Optional on write so older clients keep working; left out, the rule takes its default settings. Reads always return it.

days.description: Weekdays the window applies to (0 = Sunday)

api_key.description: Required on create; omit on update to keep the stored key

PriorityPresetMap.description: Priority rank (1..100, lower goes first) per *arr application kind.

brand_mark.description: Installation-wide brand mark shown when a user has no override.

global_hourly_cap.description: Shared stamina across every instance for setups where several *arr apps hit the same indexers (0 = off).

llm_enabled.description: Whether the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at /api/v1/mcp is enabled.

llm_write_tools.description: MCP write tools enabled by the administrator; an omitted list enables none.

sfw_mode.description: Installation-wide SFW mode applied when a user has no override.

api_key.description: Required on create; omit on update to keep stored key
